content: मोट्टायितम् Silent involuntary expression of affection towards an absent lover, as when a woman, her mind being taken up by her lover, scratches the ear <ab>&c.</ab> when he is remembered or talked of; it is thus defined by उज्ज्वलमणि:-- कान्तस्मरणवार्तादौ हृदि तद्भावभावतः . प्राकठ्यसभिलाषस्य मोट्टायितमुदीर्यते; see <ls>S. D. 141</ls> also; सद्यो मोट्टायितमधुरिमोल्लासभङ्गीविधाता <ls>Ud. S. 35</ls>.
